object.attr: derived: agents branch on `error_type`, so the set is closed, and a rewrite returns the same strings. Result fields stay with each area's tool requirements; this keeps only the closed list (review Q2, Q5). TBD values are open.
object.description: The MCP server shall return as `error_type` only the values in this requirement's table.

row.cell: a write tool call adds an item that already exists (MELLON-MCP-SRS-52)
a write tool call names a missing item or gives a value that is refused (MELLON-MCP-SRS-53)
the operating system refuses to read or write a file (MELLON-MCP-SRS-54)
the read-only server refuses a call (MELLON-MCP-SRS-100)
PDF export can't find or run its typesetter (MELLON-PDF-SRS)
a tool other than a write tool is given a document or object that doesn't exist (MELLON-MCP-SRS-61)
